name: Mycorrhizal, contact and short-distance
description: A mantle on each colonised root tip with little or no soil mycelium beyond a halo of millimetres, and no cords. The network is effectively the root system; individuals are small and spread with roots and spores.

tip_speed.note: low part of the 0.25 to 0.95 mm/day (10 to 40 um/h) measured for ectomycorrhizal isolates on agar at 22 C (research/08 [25]). Tuber in culture is far slower, about 0.02 mm/day (research/08 [24]); in soil the family follows root growth (research/02 section 4)

growth_unit.note: no measurement found; set short for a dense halo of short hyphae

branch_angle.note: default from Hopkins & Boswell 2012 (79 +/- 10 deg, research/09); not measured for this family

branch_angle_sd.note: default from Hopkins & Boswell 2012 (79 +/- 10 deg, research/09); not measured for this family

sensitivity.note: how strongly tips turn away from crowding; model coefficient

fusion_probability.note: chance a tip that meets a hypha fuses and does not cross; no measurement found

density_cap.note: hyphal density at which branching stops; tuning value for a dense halo

explore.note: willingness to grow over bare soil; mycelium stays within millimetres of root tips (research/02 section 4, distance from memory there); tuning value

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / 100 so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found

inactivation_rate.note: from Rhizoctonia solani (Boswell et al. 2003, research/09); not a member of this family (0.5 per day)

degradation_rate.note: none seen in 15 h in R. solani; small value so dead hyphae clear

passive_transport.note: diffusion between neighbouring segments; measured diffusion inside hyphae (1 to 2 x 10^-9 m2/s, research/10) is several times faster than the passes allow

soil.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from the family's ecology, not measured

wood.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from the family's ecology, not measured

litter.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from the family's ecology, not measured

root.note: a mycorrhizal root tip is wrapped in a mantle with a large exchange surface, so uptake there is set well above a single hypha's; tuning value, as in Laccaria bicolor

agar.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from the family's ecology, not measured

transport_speed.note: no measurement for this family; near the 14.4 mm/h ceiling for motor transport and the 18 mm/h mass flow measured in Neurospora (research/10)

cold_drop.note: most members fruit in autumn or winter (research/08, unchecked); size of the drop is a guess

wobble.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

avoidance.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

fusion_probability.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

uptake.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

turn.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

spike_interval.note: default; no recording for any member of this family (research/04)

spike_duration.note: default; no recording for any member of this family (research/04)

spike_amplitude.note: default; no recording for any member of this family (research/04)

score.note: default; mycorrhizal fungi are not in the wood-decay combat hierarchy (research/06)
